title: CHAPTER 024 - Safe serialized handover v3.5 to v3.6
description: Complete automated repair chapter based on Chapter 023 evidence. Uses JSON-safe forward-slash paths only inside the generated helper. Verifies v3.6 hash and syntax, backs up state/runners, captures the active v3.5 PID, generates and syntax-checks a delayed helper, arms it, and verifies the helper process. After task 024 is finalized in state, the helper starts v3.6, verifies v3.6 is running, then retires only the captured v3.5 process and writes a final handover report.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=$root+'/backups/024/'+$stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null; foreach($name in @('3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1','3en-agent.state.json','3en-agent.log','switch-to-v36-024.ps1')){$src=$root+'/'+$name;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination ($bk+'/'+$name) -Force}}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_024_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $v36=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $stateFile=$root+'/3en-agent.state.json'; $helper=$root+'/switch-to-v36-024.ps1'; test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $helper='C:/3EN-Agent/switch-to-v36-024.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $helper)){throw 'handover helper missing'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('HELPER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($err).Count); if(@($err).Count -ne 0){throw 'handover helper syntax invalid'}; $armed=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*switch-to-v36-024.ps1*'}); Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PROCESS_COUNT='+$armed.Count); if($armed.Count -lt 1){throw 'handover helper is not running'}; Write-Host 'CHAPTER_024_PRE_FINALIZE_TEST=PASS'; Write-Host 'SERIALIZATION_SAFE_PATHS=PASS'; Write-Host 'After task finalization helper performs the verified handover automatically.'
